# Anatomy

Build crafted, highly detailed, interactive isometric SVG figures that explain a technical idea as a real physical object: many small precise solid parts, four-tone shading, correct painter's order, a framed card with title, hint and live readout, and calm eased motion. Framework-free (standalone HTML or SVG) or React/Next.js, with optional in-drawing WebGL shaders, an optional beta 3D mode, a geometry audit and headless-Chrome checks, printable A4/Letter PDF sheets, and — only on your explicit ask and confirmation — publishing to the Anatomy community gallery.
